summary: Frontend-only visual regression testing for green->blue pastel color change. Verified theme.success is now #5B95E8 (rgb 91,149,232) and datePillOngoing uses #DCE9FF. No green colors detected on any screen (Profile, Mes matchs, Club detail). Verified badge 'Joueur vérifié' displays with blue background; 'Premium actif' card displays with blue background; 4/4 badge on Mes matchs (Passés) displays in blue. Login, tab navigation (Clubs/Messages/Profil), club detail with annonces, and Mes matchs (À venir/En cours/Passés) all render without errors — no functional regression.
critical_code_review_comments: colors.success (#5B95E8) is used in multiple semantic contexts: (a) verified badge/pill, (b) premium active card, (c) status 'En cours' tag, (d) 'Match confirmé · 4/4' badge, (e) 4/4 in Mes matchs, and (f) 'Joueurs notés' text in matches.tsx. All now render blue as expected. If future design requires different semantics (e.g., true success/confirmation vs. informational blue), consider introducing a dedicated `info`/`accent` color token to decouple concerns.
The literal '#DCE9FF' hardcoded in club/[id].tsx (line 514, datePillOngoing) bypasses the theme. Consider adding it as `colors.successMuted` or `colors.infoMuted` in theme.ts for consistency.
